jobs.description:
Are you driven to grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact? At Apex, we’re building more than a consulting and engineering firm—we’re creating a place where your career accelerates, your contributions matter, and your potential is fully realized. We believe your growth is our growth, which is why we invest in your development at every stage of your career. Here, you’ll work on projects that shape communities, protect the environment, and create lasting impact, all while being empowered with the autonomy and flexibility to do your best work.

Fueled by high quality delivery, exceptional client retention, and strategic acquisitions, Apex Companies continues to rank among the fastest-growing firms in the AEC industry, recently recognized by the Zweig Group for our industry-leading growth. Our success is grounded in strong leadership, a collaborative culture, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes.

As we continue to expand, we're looking for high-performing professionals who are ready to lead, collaborate, innovate, and create impact. At Apex, you help shape what's next. When we succeed together, we share in that success. All Apex positions are eligible for annual bonus opportunities, reinforcing our commitment to recognizing and rewarding meaningful contributions that drive our collective growth.

Part Time – Senior, Hazardous Waste Safety and Environmental Specialist – Portland, Oregon

Introduction

Are you a highly motivated self-starter seeking to join a growth-focused Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) consulting firm? Are you looking for a company that will provide interesting and technically challenging work and will also invest in your development and grow your professional skills? If so, consider a career with Apex. Powered by strong sales, extraordinary client retention, multiple career path options, strategic acquisitions, and an entrepreneurial spirit, Apex Companies is one of the fastest growing EHS consulting firms in the USA. We take pride in meeting and exceeding our clients’ expectations and have earned numerous industry awards for project excellence. We continue to grow, and we want you to grow with us.

Role Overview

This role is to provide overarching Hazardous Waste and Environmental Safety expertise to one of Apex’s most valued clients, a national aerospace manufacturer. Over the last 2 decades Apex has worked hand and hand with the national aerospace manufacturer helping them achieve their occupational health and safety, ergonomic, environmental and engineering goals. The incumbent will serve as a Hazardous Waste and Environmental Specialist to support site-wide hazardous waste and environmental compliance operations. This is a part time role with up to 40 hours a week based on client’s request.

The incumbent will be dedicated full time to supporting the sites hazardous waste and environmental compliance operations. The individual in this role will work closely with environmental, engineering, maintenance, leadership, and EHS stakeholders to assist with closing any and all hazardous waste and compliance gaps identified as well as supporting the day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities

Project Background

Hazardous waste background, including familiarity with Oregon’s Dangerous and Hazardous Waste regulations
Familiar with EPA hazardous and dangerous waste regulations
Familiar with related records (manifests, hazardous waste invoices, MSD, etc.)
Environmental compliance-oriented
Able to conduct walking inspections of RCRA accumulation/satellite areas
able to document and photograph areas of concern, then develop professional emails to convey desired mitigation
able to conduct follow-up inspections to ensure corrective measures were implemented
DOT trained -- desirable, but not required, and they would not be expected to sign manifests
Reasonable computer skills (data entry, email, able to pick up basic operations on the client’s internal data base and programs.
Able to work as part of a team with client’s current Environmental employees dedicated to hazardous waste compliance at the site.

Scope of Work

Factory Dust Disposal Project
Sampling
Tracking (locations & disposal requests)
Site Inspections – Small Quantity Generators
Land Disposal Restrictions - Review/Update Project Support
Battery Collection Location Updates w/HazMat
RCRA Inspection Forms - compile, organize
Invoice Reviews & Approvals
Hazmat ECTs HW trainings – help develop a mini training program on regulatory compliance and policies at the site.
Visit crew meetings to train individuals or very small groups on policies, program aspects, compliance, etc
Ability to give small presentations is desirable but not required – we can do the presentations if needed

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, environmental, waste management, chemical or a related technical discipline required.
Minimum 15 years of progressive hazardous waste and or waste management, engineering, environmental/hazardous waste compliance. (Experience and education will be accounted for appropriately).
40 hour HAZWOPER
Desired but not required:
OSHA 30
Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM)
Certified Professional in Waste Management (CPWM)
Hazardous Waste Management Specialist (HMS)
Excellent communication, training, technical writing, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and standard safety documentation and reporting practices.
Valid driver’s license required.

Select Key Performance Indicators

Demonstrates the ability to work independently, successfully executing technical projects with minimal supervision.
Customer needs are met on a timely basis and emergencies are responded to quickly.
Meets annually established goals for personally-generated revenue, and utilization %.
Meets annually established goals for Customer satisfaction.
Pursues ongoing professional development as mutually agreed with the Business Unit Manager.

Why Join Apex

Apex Companies is a strong place to build an environmental and EHS career. You will get meaningful, hands on work with diverse clients, the backing of an experienced national team, and clear opportunities to grow your technical and leadership skills. You’re exposed to projects that span industrial hygiene, hazardous waste, stormwater, and environmental compliance, so your day to day work stays challenging and relevant. At the same time, Apex emphasizes collaboration, mentorship, and professional development, making it easier to pursue advanced certifications and long term career goals while contributing to projects that genuinely protect people and the environment.

Job Location:

Portland, OR

Schedule

Part time – up to 40 hours per week

Travel

Not Expected

Compensation

$82/ hour

Req ID: 11968

Hourly Expected Pay Range: $82 USD - $82 USD

jobs.title: Environmental Specialist
jobs.description:
About This Role

We are currently seeking an experienced Environment Specialist to join the Asset Retirement HSE team of a leading global oil & gas organisation.

This is a 2-year contract opportunity working on a FIFO 2 weeks on / 2 weeks off roster, providing hands-on environmental support across a major Asset Retirement program encompassing decommissioning, remediation, well abandonment and associated project activities.

Reporting to the HSE Team Lead - Asset Retirement, you will work closely with project teams, contractors, operational personnel and environmental specialists to support the safe, compliant and environmentally responsible delivery of Asset Retirement activities.

The Role

The Environment Specialist will provide practical environmental guidance and assurance across field-based operations and projects, with a strong focus on environmental compliance, risk management and continuous improvement.

Key responsibilities will include:

Conducting field-based environmental assurance, verification and validation activities across Asset Retirement worksites.
Supporting environmental monitoring and sampling programs covering air, water, waste and soil.
Providing support across waste management, fauna handling and other environmental field activities.
Supporting environmental risk assessments and the implementation of appropriate controls.
Developing and delivering environmental training, awareness initiatives and environmental leadership programs.
Supporting teams and contractors to build environmental capability and improve environmental performance.
Participating in projects and working groups relating to environmental risk, waste management, contaminated land, rehabilitation and continuous improvement.
Building effective working relationships across HSE, project teams, contractors, business partners, regulators and corporate environmental teams.
Supporting environmental regulatory approvals, compliance obligations, audits and reporting requirements.
Participating in Incident Management and Emergency Response activities, including emergency exercises and response events.
Supporting environmental and wildlife response activities where required.
Facilitating incident investigations and learning events using recognised methodologies including 5-Why, SAFE, Why-Tree and Learning Teams.
Applying Human and Organizational Performance (HOP) principles to support sustainable improvements in environmental and HSE performance.

Requirements

To be considered for this opportunity, you will ideally have:

A Diploma or Degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Management or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience applying environmental management systems and environmental risk management principles in a practical operational or project environment.
Strong field-based environmental experience and the ability to provide practical advice to frontline personnel and contractors.
Excellent stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
The confidence to operate as a visible HSE professional and engage effectively with leaders, frontline workers, contractors and regulators.
Strong communication skills with the ability to adapt your approach to different stakeholder groups.
The ability and willingness to work a FIFO 2:2 roster.
You must have current right to work in Australia to be considered for this role

Experience in some or all of the following will be highly regarded:

Environmental assurance, compliance,monitoring and sampling
Contaminated land management and remediation.
Waste management.
Fauna handling.
Emergency response and oil spill response..
Major projects, construction or operational environments.
Decommissioning, remediation or Asset Retirement activities.

Benefits

Work for a global oil and gas business
FIFO 2:2 roster
2 year contract
Salary sacrificing
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Corporate discounts

About Brunel:

Brunel is a recruitment and flexible workforce solution provider which connects talented people with opportunities throughout Australasia and around the world. We specialise in highly skilled roles across a variety of technical, professional, trades and craft disciplines, pairing candidates with industry-leading projects and organisations on a contract, permanent or secondment basis.

Operating in Australasia since 1997, Brunel has major bases of operation in Perth, Sydney, Brisbane, Melbourne and Port Moresby, which are further backed by the strength and reach of a truly global network spanning over 45 countries, 120 offices and 50 years of successful operation.

Brunel is proud to be equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander and female candidates.

Click the link to apply or email your CV direct to Michael Shirley at m.shirley@brunel.net
